definitions.explanation: A building or section of a hospital where patients are housed, typically organized by medical specialty or patient type.

examples.japanese: {病棟|びょうとう}を{見舞|みま}いに{行|い}く。
examples.english: To go visit someone in the hospital ward.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{病棟|びょうとう}は{来年|らいねん}{完成|かんせい}する{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: The new hospital ward is scheduled to be completed next year.

examples.japanese: {感染症|かんせんしょう}{患者|かんじゃ}は{専用|せんよう}の{病棟|びょうとう}に{隔離|かくり}されている。
examples.english: Patients with infectious diseases are isolated in a dedicated ward.

notes:
Refers to the physical building or wing of a hospital where inpatients stay. Japanese hospitals are often organized into multiple {病棟|びょうとう}, each specializing in different areas of care.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入院|にゅういん}{病棟|びょうとう}: inpatient ward
- {外来|がいらい}{病棟|びょうとう}: outpatient wing
- {小児|しょうに}{病棟|びょうとう}: pediatric ward
- {精神|せいしん}{病棟|びょうとう}: psychiatric ward
- {閉鎖|へいさ}{病棟|びょうとう}: closed ward (locked psychiatric unit)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {病室|びょうしつ}: hospital room — a single room within a ward
- {病院|びょういん}: hospital — the entire medical facility
- {診療所|しんりょうじょ}: clinic — a smaller medical facility, typically without inpatient beds
